text:
jin: Quick ask — I need to give a contractor access to triage LLM trace logs in Console/Stackdriver and possibly the BigQuery export. They must NOT be able to see raw PII. What’s the minimal role or flow? Prefer 1h window if possible.

carla: Don’t give broad Project Viewer. Two paths: 1) create a project-scoped custom role that only includes logging read perms (e.g., logging.logEntries.list, logging.logMetrics.list, logging.views.get) and no BigQuery/storage permissions; 2) if they need BQ rows, create a redacted view or a redacted export and grant read on that dataset only.

sam: Recommend using our JIT access flow for contractors. Open a 1hr JIT request and attach a custom role — avoids long-lived bindings. :thumbsup:

jin: Can you paste an example gcloud snippet for the custom role + binding?

carla: Sure — example (project-scoped custom role + binding):

```
# create custom role (one-time)
gcloud iam roles create LlmLogTriage --project=my-project \
  --title="LLM Log Triage" \
  --permissions="logging.logEntries.list,logging.logMetrics.list,logging.views.get" \
  --stage=GA

# bind to user (use JIT group or temp principal instead of direct user when possible)
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding my-project \
  --member="user:contractor@example.com" \
  --role="projects/my-project/roles/LlmLogTriage"
```

Note: do NOT include `bigquery.jobs.get` or `bigquery.tables.getData` if you want to prevent raw export access. If they absolutely need BQ rows, set up a dataset with a redacted view and grant `roles/bigquery.dataViewer` only on that dataset.

sec-bot: Policy check — Any access that might expose telemetry with PII requires: 1) privacy approval (privacy@) logged in ticket, 2) DLP redaction flag on the export or proof of redaction, and 3) audit entry in #audit-access with request id.

alyssa: Another option: share sanitized sample logs in a secure bucket and give the contractor `roles/storage.objectViewer` on that single bucket. Keeps live telemetry locked down.

jin: OK — plan: request 1h JIT, create custom LlmLogTriage role with only logging perms, avoid BQ perms, and if needed use a redacted dataset or shared sanitized bucket. Assigning @sam to run the role creation and JIT.

sam: On it — I’ll open the JIT request and submit a small terraform change using our `iam/temp-role` module. I’ll post PR + JIT ticket link here when ready. :eyes:

carla: Quick follow-up: make sure the role docs include the exact permissions list and a short justification so privacy can approve faster. Also add an expiry label to the binding (where supported) or record expiry in the JIT ticket.

jin: Will do. Thanks all.

sam: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4567 — JIT ticket TCK-789. I’ll wait for privacy sign-off.

sec-bot: Reminder: after access is used, run `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"WriteLogEntries\"" --limit 50` and attach any relevant audit logs to TCK-789 for the record.
